title: Pushforward from an open of a coherent module with support closed in the ambient scheme is coherent
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $j:U\to X$ the inclusion of an open subscheme and $T\subseteq X$ a closed subset with $T\subseteq U$. If $\mathcal F$ is a coherent $\mathcal O_U$-module [pqf-def-coherent] with $\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F)\subseteq T$ [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base], then $j_*\mathcal F$ is a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module; indeed $(j_*\mathcal F)|_U=\mathcal F$ and $(j_*\mathcal F)|_{X\setminus T}=0$.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 0CYJ (lemma-pushforward-coherent-on-open) and its proof
